record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare FUTURE_SIGHT: Ralts (1 star, range 3, no passive), Kirlia (2 stars, range 3, passive KIRLIA) and Gardevoir (3 stars, range 3, no passive). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (both tables) and Kirlia's passive, which is not covered.
record.summary: On cast the caster picks up to 3/4/5 (by stars 1/2/3; 6 at 4 stars or fallback) distinct random enemies anywhere on the board and, after a 2000 ms delay, deals SPECIAL damage 20/30/50 (80 at 4 stars or fallback) to each one still alive. In the same delayed step every enemy in the 8 cells adjacent to each chosen target's position (whether or not that enemy was itself picked) takes SPECIAL damage equal to round(0.2 x raw damage). AP and the cast crit flag apply to both parts. The base process still spends maxPP of PP.

targeting.who: up to N random distinct enemies from every enemy entity on the board (no range or visibility check), chosen at cast time; at impact each target's current position is used for the adjacency splash
targeting.note: requiresTarget is false, so the cast does not need an attack target; if no enemy exists nothing is chosen and the delayed command does nothing.

geometry.shape: up to N single targets plus the 8 adjacent cells around each target's position at impact time (centre excluded)

effects.target: each chosen enemy still alive at impact
effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied by handleSpecialDamage: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); if the cast crit (only with ABILITY_CRIT since canCritByDefault is false) x 1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor, with Rocky Helmet cancelling and Black Augurite reducing the bonus.
effects.resolution: then PokemonState.handleDamage: SPECIAL damage divided by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef, non-TRUE flat reductions, at least 1, shield before HP; protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target block the hit. takenDamage includes shield damage. The primary hit is skipped if the target has hp <= 0 when the command fires, 2000 ms after the cast.

effects.target: every enemy-team entity in a cell adjacent to a chosen target's position (splash)
effects.scaling: requested = Math.round(damage x 0.2) = 4 / 6 / 10 for 20 / 30 / 50; then the same AP multiplier and crit factor as the primary hit are applied inside handleSpecialDamage (apBoost default true).
effects.resolution: same handleDamage resolution as the primary hit. The splash is applied per chosen target, with no check that the adjacent entity is alive other than the cell holding it; an enemy adjacent to several chosen targets is hit once per adjacency, and an enemy that is itself chosen can also be hit by the splash of neighbouring chosen targets. A dead primary target does not stop its splash.

starBehavior.note: Both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars. The 4-star values (80 damage, 6 targets) are not used by these units at their factory values. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Targets are enemies anywhere on the board; the splash uses the target's board position when the delayed command fires, so a target that has moved takes its splash at the new position.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast creates its own target list and one delayed command; overlapping casts are independent.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 20 / 30 / 50 per chosen target and round(0.2 x damage) = 4 / 6 / 10 splash. Requested = raw; applied = raw x (1 + AP/100) (x crit factor if the cast crit), divided by 1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef, minus flat reductions, minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. The sum over a volley is not computed here for a specific board.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after later modifiers in handleDamage (shields, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL defence division, the non-TRUE flat reductions block and the minimum of 1 were read
